tasks.title: Essay: Institutional evaluation of hybrid communication practice
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText: Your university senate is discussing how to improve hybrid communication – the use of email, messaging platforms and in-person meetings for teaching and administration. You have made the notes below.

promptBlocks.heading: Priorities for a hybrid communication charter
Some opinions expressed in the discussion:
paragraphs: "Response-time expectations reduce anxiety – everyone knows when to expect a reply."
"Channel clarity stops confusion: use email for formal notices, messaging for quick questions."
"Protected offline periods let staff and students disconnect without guilt."

promptBlocks.text: Write an essay for your tutor discussing two of the priorities in your notes. You should explain which priority you think is more important for the university to adopt, giving reasons in support of your answer. You may, if you wish, make use of the opinions expressed in the discussion, but you should use your own words as far as possible.

tasks.title: Proposal: University communication charter
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
The university executive committee has decided to develop a formal communication charter for all hybrid teaching and administration. The committee has invited proposals from staff and students on how the charter should be structured.

Write a proposal for the executive committee. In your proposal, you should:

• recommend channel standards for different types of communication
• suggest how staff and student training on the charter should be organised
• describe a complaint route for when the charter is not followed

Write your proposal.

tasks.title: Email: Response to external quality auditor
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You are the head of the university's communication review team. An external quality auditor has sent you a report highlighting several communication failures in hybrid teaching and administration, and has requested a response.

Write an email to the external quality auditor. In your email, you should:

• explain the root cause of the communication failures
• describe the corrective measures the university is implementing
• arrange a meeting to review the evidence of improvement

Write your email.

tasks.title: Review: Hybrid communication policy
tasks.instruction: Answer one of the following questions (2–4). Write 220–260 words in an appropriate style.
tasks.promptText:
You see this announcement in a higher-education leadership publication.

Reviews wanted: Hybrid communication policies

Our publication is running a series of reviews of hybrid communication policies adopted by universities. Have you experienced or observed a policy that aims to regulate communication across digital and in-person channels? Write a review for our publication.

In your review, evaluate the clarity of the policy's guidelines, assess its impact on organisational culture, and consider the risks involved in implementing such a policy.

Write your review.
